items.title: Elements of a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring that agree in every minimal-prime localization agree in some power
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a_1, a_2 in the maximal ideal of a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring A with equal images in the product of the A_p over minimal primes p satisfy a_1^n = a_2^n for some n. The proof writes a_1 = a_2 + x, proves x is nilpotent because the intersection of the minimal primes is the nilradical and the annihilator of x contains a power of m, and then expands (a_2 + x)^(k+n) by the binomial theorem, with every cross term killed either by a power of x or by a high power of a_2 in m (proof lines 7591-7602). H2: combining nilpotency of x with the binomial expansion under the maximal-ideal hypothesis is the non-routine step.
